operator_direction: Add synthesized modem connection noises after dialing 555-1212, correct full-capacity USB MSC writes on the ESP32-P4 32-bit ABI, recover the confirmed corrupt card through H2, and install every enabled game under SD GAMES for dynamic discovery without embedding games in firmware.
